children: StonkBrokers releases Leverage Machine, a permissionless on-chain options exchange on Robinhood Chain powered by STORMM. The platform lets users provide liquidity with stock tokens or ETH and trade options minted as NFTs.

The September 2026 launch gives the project a functioning venue for options activity rather than a product announcement alone. Platform adoption and usage will determine how much activity the exchange generates and, in turn, how closely that progress is reflected in STONKBROKER's repricing. The product's design also links participation to liquidity provision and on-chain options trading, so sustained use would depend on users engaging with both parts of the platform.

title: StonkBroker: Leverage Machine launches - Sep 2026
